Deroy & Devereaux Private Investment Counsel Inc. Reduces Position in Apple Inc. (AAPL) Posted by Paula Ricardo | Feb 1st, 2018 
Deroy & Devereaux Private Investment Counsel Inc. lessened its stake in Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) by 0.6% in the 3rd quarter, according to the company in its most recent Form 13F filing with the SEC. The firm owned 156,594 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock after selling 948 shares during the period. Apple comprises 2.7% of Deroy & Devereaux Private Investment Counsel Inc.’s portfolio, making the stock its biggest holding. Deroy & Devereaux Private Investment Counsel Inc.’s holdings in Apple were worth $24,134,000 as of its most recent filing with the SEC. 
Several other hedge funds and other institutional investors also recently added to or reduced their stakes in the stock. Blue Sky Asset Management LLC bought a new position in shares of Apple in the second quarter valued at approximately $108,000. Hefty Wealth Partners raised its stake in shares of Apple by 27.6% in the second quarter. Hefty Wealth Partners now owns 804 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock valued at $115,000 after acquiring an additional 174 shares during the last quarter. FNY Managed Accounts LLC raised its stake in shares of Apple by 852.4% in the second quarter. FNY Managed Accounts LLC now owns 800 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock valued at $115,000 after acquiring an additional 716 shares during the last quarter. Private Vista LLC bought a new position in shares of Apple in the second quarter valued at approximately $122,000. Finally, Armbruster Capital Management Inc. raised its stake in shares of Apple by 9.4% in the second quarter. Armbruster Capital Management Inc. now owns 911 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock valued at $131,000 after acquiring an additional 78 shares during the last quarter. Institutional investors and hedge funds own 60.26% of the company’s stock. Get Apple alerts: 
Shares of Apple Inc. ( AAPL ) traded up $0.35 during midday trading on Thursday, reaching $167.78. 43,831,342 shares of the company’s stock traded hands, compared to its average volume of 29,150,000. The company has a debt-to-equity ratio of 0.73, a quick ratio of 1.23 and a current ratio of 1.28. Apple Inc. has a 1 year low of $127.01 and a 1 year high of $180.10. The firm has a market cap of $861,430.00, a PE ratio of 18.26, a P/E/G ratio of 1.35 and a beta of 1.23. 
Apple (NASDAQ:AAPL) last announced its quarterly earnings results on Thursday, February 1st. The iPhone maker reported $3.89 earnings per share (EPS) for the quarter, beating the Thomson Reuters’ consensus estimate of $3.75 by $0.14. Apple had a net margin of 21.09% and a return on equity of 36.29%. The firm had revenue of $88.29 billion during the quarter, compared to analysts’ expectations of $87.62 billion. During the same period in the prior year, the company posted $3.36 EPS. The company’s revenue was up 12.7% on a year-over-year basis. analysts expect that Apple Inc. will post 11.13 EPS for the current year. 
The company also recently disclosed a quarterly dividend, which will be paid on Thursday, February 15th. Stockholders of record on Monday, February 12th will be given a dividend of $0.63 per share. This represents a $2.52 annualized dividend and a dividend yield of 1.50%. Apple’s dividend payout ratio (DPR) is presently 27.42%. 
A number of analysts recently weighed in on AAPL shares. Drexel Hamilton reissued a “buy” rating and issued a $208.00 price target on shares of Apple in a report on Monday, October 9th. UBS Group reissued a “buy” rating and issued a $180.00 price target on shares of Apple in a report on Monday, October 9th. Vetr lowered shares of Apple from a “strong-buy” rating to a “buy” rating and set a $173.47 price target for the company. in a report on Friday, October 6th. Robert W. Baird reissued a “buy” rating and issued a $175.00 price target (up previously from $172.00) on shares of Apple in a report on Wednesday, October 4th. Finally, Piper Jaffray Companies reissued a “buy” rating and issued a $196.00 price target on shares of Apple in a report on Wednesday, October 11th. Two analysts have rated the stock with a sell rating, twelve have issued a hold rating, thirty-seven have issued a buy rating and two have assigned a strong buy rating to the company’s stock. The company currently has an average rating of “Buy” and a consensus target price of $201.25. 
In other news, insider Eduardo H. Cue sold 65,361 shares of the stock in a transaction on Thursday, November 30th. The shares were sold at an average price of $171.60, for a total transaction of $11,215,947.60. The transaction was disclosed in a legal filing with the Securities & Exchange Commission, which is available through the SEC website . Also, SVP Johny Srouji sold 5,760 shares of the stock in a transaction on Wednesday, November 22nd. The stock was sold at an average price of $174.40, for a total transaction of $1,004,544.00. Following the sale, the senior vice president now owns 81,560 shares of the company’s stock, valued at $14,224,064. The disclosure for this sale can be found here . Over the last quarter, insiders have sold 128,412 shares of company stock valued at $22,115,155. 0.08% of the stock is currently owned by corporate insiders.
